custom-code-zu5Ezr.code:
Shop FAQ

Where is Salida Mountain Sports?

We are at 110 N F Street in downtown Salida, Colorado. Call us at (719) 539-4400 or email info@salidamtnsports.com.

What are your hours?

Monday through Saturday 10am to 6pm, and Sunday 10am to 5pm.

Can I order online and pick up in the shop?

Yes. Choose free in-store pickup at checkout and pick up your order at 110 N F Street.

How does shipping work?

Shipping is calculated at checkout at live carrier rates based on what's in your box. Fuel, bear spray and aerosols are pickup only. Free in-store pickup on every order.

What is your return policy for online orders?

Unused items in original packaging with tags can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Sale items, electronics and safety gear such as beacons, probes and helmets are final sale. Email info@salidamtnsports.com with your order number to start a return.

Do you offer ski tuning and boot fitting?

Yes. Our full-service ski shop does tunes from a $30 hot wax to a $100 stone tune, binding mounts, and custom boot fitting with MasterFit InstaPrint footbeds. See our Ski Shop page for all rates.

Can I rent backcountry skis or a splitboard?

Yes. AT, telemark and splitboard packages are $100 a day, and we rent cross country skis, snowshoes, shovels, probes and skins. Call (719) 539-4400 or stop by the shop to reserve.
